$about: The strangler proof's Slim 4 app (slim/slim-skeleton 4.5.0, MIT). prove.sh records these answers on before/ and checks the mounted copy against them.

requests.name: an encoded slash (the skeleton answers 405: only its OPTIONS catch-all matches)
a trailing slash is another path (405, the OPTIONS catch-all)
an unknown path (405, the OPTIONS catch-all)
POST where only GET is routed (405 with Allow)
a path .htaccess redirects (under Apache; php -S has no .htaccess, so the skeleton's 405)
a file .htaccess denies (under Apache; php -S serves it)
a folder with no index (Apache: 403; the router: the skeleton's 405)
the same folder without the slash (Apache: 301 to add it)
a folder with an index.html (Apache serves it; the router: 405)
